{{Quote|It was a humble start; I didn't have anything on the menu except donuts and fresh-brewed caf.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
'''Dex's Donuts''' was a [[Doughnut/Legends|donut]] [[Restaurant/Legends|stand]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] that [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] donuts and [[Caf/Legends|caf]]. It was operated by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who opened the stand with the last of his savings. After Dex's Donuts was destroyed by a [[Unidentified air taxi driver|taxi driver]] by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]], Jettster was able to use settlement [[Currency/Legends|money]] from the [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]] company to open a proper diner, [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner.]]

==Description==
{{Quote|As you can imagine, it's not easy eking out a living selling food on the sidewalk.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
Dex's Donuts was a small [[Restaurant/Legends|stand]] located on a sidewalk at the corner of [[Avenue Peth]] and [[Zevanth Street]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. It [[Merchant/Legends|sold]] only [[Doughnut/Legends|donuts]] and freshly brewed [[Caf/Legends|caf]] and was owned by the [[Besalisk/Legends|Besalisk]] [[Chef/Legends|chef]] [[Dexter Jettster/Legends|Dexter Jettster]], who was assisted by a [[Dexter Jettster's Crisp-E-O donut droid|Crisp-E-O donut droid]].<ref name="Dex" />

==History==
{{Quote|As luck would have it, around that time an inattentive driver landed his air taxi on Dex's Donuts.|The menu at Dex's Diner|<ref name="Dex" />}}
[[File:DexterJettster-FF44.png|thumb|right|240px|Dexter Jettster opened Dex's Donuts.]]
Jettster opened Dex's Donuts after using the last of his savings traveling to Coruscant, having been fed up with his previous jobs that had kept him on the run from [[Police officer/Legends|police officers]]. Jettster later called the beginning of the stand a humble start, as it was difficult to make a living while selling sidewalk [[Foodstuff/Legends|food]], especially as much of the traffic was in [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeders]] [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] above. After a number of trying [[Standard year/Legends|years]], Jettster began to look into buying a new location that would serve as a real restaurant, but his modest income from the stand made such a venture seem impossible.<ref name="Dex" />

Luckily for Jettster,<ref name="Dex" /> by [[27 BBY/Legends|27 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> an [[Unidentified air taxi driver|inattentive taxi driver]] crash-landed on the stand in his [[Air taxi/Legends|air taxi]], obliterating it. Although Jettster was not initially fortunate&mdash;he had a cracked cranial crest and three broken [[Limb/Legends|arms]]&mdash;he received a settlement [[Currency/Legends|payment]] from the air taxi company and was able to open up a proper [[Cafe/Legends|café]] called [[Dex's Diner/Legends|Dex's Diner]]. He continued to use the same [[Crisp-E-O donut droid|donut droid]] there, and he included the story about Dex's Donuts in the diner's menu.<ref name="Dex" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|The idea that Dex started with a donut stand was modeled after the experience of Denny's founder Harold Butler, who began his business as Danny's Donuts.|Gregory Walker|<ref name="Blog">{{Blog|narbflick|11|Dining at Dex's: The Story Behind the Story}}</ref>}}
Dex's Donuts was mentioned in "[[Dining at Dex's]]," a [[2009]] [[Hyperspace: The Official Star Wars Fan Club|Hyperspace]]-exclusive article which was written by [[Gregory Walker]] and formatted as an [[in-universe]] menu.<ref name="Dex" /> Walker created Dex's Donuts in order to write a definitive story for the origin of Dex's Diner. He was inspired by the story of the founder of<ref name="Blog" /> the restaurant chain<ref name="Denny">{{WebCite|url=https://www.dennys.com/company/about|text=About Us|work=[[Wikipedia:Denny's|Denny's]]|archivedate=20210816004746}}</ref> [[Wikipedia:Denny's|Denny's]], [[Wikipedia:Harold Butler|Harold Butler]], who started his establishment as "Danny's Donuts."<ref name="Blog" />
